cards.card_text: Now it's the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes.
cards.verse_text: Now in the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when wine was set before him, I took the wine and gave it to the king.

cards.card_text: In the twelfth year of King Xerxes, in the first month, Nisan, the Pur is cast before Haman to pick a day and a month.
cards.verse_text: In the twelfth year of King Xerxes, in the first month, the month of Nisan, the Pur (that is, the lot) was cast before Haman to determine a day and month.
